title: DOE Genesis project

tellings.quote: And now the Department of Energy has this Genesis project which is sort of I think a way to collate and collect all the information from all of the national labs and run it through AI

plain: The Department of Energy, the US agency that runs the country's national laboratories, has a Genesis project. Michels thinks it is a way to collect the information from all the national labs and run it through artificial intelligence. He says this himself, as his own understanding, in a 2026 episode about the Secretary of Energy speaking on UFOs.
